title: what do you guys think about my MMORPG first reel?
author: GastonSaillen
selftext:
I have been working on this game like for the past 2 months, already 120 people played it and im not planning to stop.

 Im feeling really good that the community behind it is a really nice one and looking forward to get more feedback.

From the first impression of the video, what do you guys think about the game, is it tempting for you to try it after seeing the video?

comments.author: Bmpgames
comments.body: What did you use to make it? Unreal?

replies.author: GastonSaillen
replies.body: No game engine, just typescript and babylon JS

replies.author: Bmpgames
replies.body: Wow ok will try that for my next game this is amazing! Good job!

comments.author: ImakeAIslop
comments.body:
Only based on the video. I say it looks like a fighting game without rpg mechanics. If you have npc's to talk to , shops , puzzles or anything would be nice to have in the video. 

If its just slash and bash thats fine too people like that . I just dont..

replies.author: GastonSaillen
replies.body: yes it has NPCs, PVP, shops, puzzles and more in the missions, already 30+ hours of game time with infinite end game and still 4 full maps in development

replies.author: ImakeAIslop
replies.body: Sounds great maybe make a video with this stuff too. This is what i care most about when i pick out these type of games.

replies.author: GastonSaillen
replies.body: thanks a lot for the feedback, you can try it out at [https://velundra.io](https://velundra.io) if you want to test it out, I think you gonna love it

replies.author: GastonSaillen
replies.body:
Did you even tried it out? A one prompt does not generate that inmense world with everything lol

It has more optimization than cyberpunk 2066 I can asure you that.

replies.author: Bmpgames
replies.body: why an ai hating non user still joins an aigamedev just solidifies why all our games will always need evil pointless villains. you cant just magic type words and create a game like this. smh.  anyway just played it my graphic card sucks on this pc. the rain is amazing. will see if i can review more when i get on my gaming laptop

replies.author: GastonSaillen
replies.body: Thanks a lot, you are so right it takes so many iterations and manual placement for almost every asset that people nowadays thinks that you do one prompt and its all done by itself

comments.author: Ravenravine2
comments.body:
your trailer would say things like "and they drop loot"   
In the thousands of MMORPGs, they all drop loot. You might need to rethink your trailer because nothing from it stands out from the other thousands of MMORPGs.
